numerical_qualification.oracle_rotation: occurrence step % 16; three rows per step; each occurrence covers eight steps per pass
numerical_qualification.metadata_repeatability_semantics: same chronological step before/after timing; diagnostic only; different steps are not required to produce different payload hashes

statistics_contract.filtering: none; retain every timing observation and every slower counterexample
statistics_contract.delta: upstream minus whole; positive means the whole-row endpoint is lower
statistics_contract.reduction: 100 * sum(upstream-whole) / sum(upstream), weighted by actual trace frequency
statistics_contract.percentile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p; empirical P95/P99 are not tail-stability proofs
statistics_contract.pairing: same round, pass and chronological trace step, in different fresh processes
statistics_contract.transition: step0 is pass_start; capacity_transition compares the preceding trace step, including 127 to0
statistics_contract.dependence: passes and trace steps are nested within four process blocks, not independent process trials

endpoint: Pinned current-KV/page preparation, required H2D, one native shared producer, sixteen sequential attention consumers and final completion.
correctness_scope: Two separate chronological qualification passes per process; every step validates all sixteen outputs structurally and checks three FP32 rows for one rotating occurrence. Timed samples are not individually FP32-qualified.
limitation: Fresh-process AB/BA blocks retain possible process/time drift. The combined row assignment and FD-removal comparison does not isolate FD merge cost, and excludes dense layers, model scheduling, sampler and serving. No full-model, split-parallel-versus-padding or end-to-end gain is established.
